cover_headline: Dow Falls 739 Points as Nvidia-Led AI Sell-Off Deepens Before Earnings
facts: The Dow fell 739.38 points (1.4%) to 51,608.17, the S&P 500 lost 1.9% and the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.5%
Nvidia fell 4.1% to $156.14 — its lowest close since July 1, 2025 — in its third straight decline since Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive
A new Commerce Department rule restricts remote access to advanced US chips, closing a leasing route used by Chinese companies

quote.text: The market was already worried about this risk before what happened at Nvidia. Now the risk has become even more serious.
quote.speaker: Zhiwei Zhang
quote.role: President and Chief Economist, Pinpoint Asset Management

end.headline: Dow Falls 739 Points as Nvidia-Led AI Sell-Off Deepens Before Earnings
end.line: Nvidia fell for a third straight day after Jensen Huang resigned, as a new chip-export rule tightened the pressure on AI stocks.
